description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for verifying the functionality of 'git status' with the file system watcher (fsmonitor) extension. It includes test setup, validation of extension behavior, repository state manipulation, and various scenarios to ensure correct integration of fsmonitor within git workflows.

methods.name: clean_repo
methods.description: Resets the repository to a clean state using 'git reset --hard' and 'git clean -fd'.

methods.name: dirty_repo
methods.description: Creates various untracked, modified, and new files to simulate a dirty repository state.

methods.name: write_integration_script
methods.description: Sets up a test hook script that outputs the current state of tracked files and directories for fsmonitor testing.
